title: Momcozy Breast Pump Hands-Free Mobile Style Wearable M6 24mm, 1Pc Cozy Red
bullets: 【Comfortable Rhythm & Fit, 30% Higher Milk Supply】Through over 1,000 trials, based on a best-selling cup mold that seamlessly contours to your breast shape, The Momcozy R&D team has perfected a pumping rhythm that enhances comfort while effectively increasing milk production 30%.

【2nd Gen Motor, Stronger Suction】The advanced 2nd Gen motor delivers a powerful 295 mmHg suction, with 3 modes (Stimulation, Expression, Mixed) and 9 adjustable levels for a more comfortable and efficient pumping experience.

【Quiet and Hidden for Privacy & Slim and Lightweight for Easy Carry】 Designed to be slim and lightweight and less 48bB while pumping, it is easy to carry around, travel, taking a walk in a public place anywhere anytime. You have more freedom from the home to world beyond.
【DoubleFit Flange, Relaxing Comfort】 Featuring a unique soft and hard silicone dual-seal flange, the Momcozy pump ensures maximum comfort, safety, and easy flange installation.
【Stand-Up Milk Bowl Design】 The stand-up milk collector simplifies pumping and pouring, making it easier to transfer milk into milk bags or bottles without spills.

【Custom Fit & Long-Lasting Power】 Available in 4 sizes (17/19/21/24mm) for a personalized fit. Up to 180 minutes (6 sessions) on one charge. Large LED display shows time, battery, and intensity. Only 4 easy-to-clean parts for time-saving convenience.
